event.detail: Reviewed commit: 647f0227b7f5b6c5fe443b2d5f0c4a20de0d5513. TLDR: considered whether the new old-terminal retry fixture corrupts a live host launch or lets its replacement reconcile without owning the state directory. Source checks refute that fixture concern. host_creates.rs:1682-1694 installs the AfterRecord crash; :1717-1730 asserts a single Launching row with empty terminal address before changing it to Tmux. core.rs:11348-11355 places AfterRecord before checkout allocation and all launch side effects, so this fixture has no started host to relabel. store.rs:5067-5102 shows set_terminal_for_test updates only sessions.terminal_kind and terminal_address and requires exactly one existing row. create_idempotency.rs:207-238 drops the first client, waits for its connection references and state-directory claim to release, constructs the replacement, and asserts replacement.owns_state_dir. The test additionally checks its row remains Tmux after that reload before invoking the retry. Governing contract: SPEC_impl.md:2312-2319 says an interrupted older tmux create keeps its kind through takeover, is refused before anything starts when takeover claims it, and settles that refusal; :2336-2341 makes host launch records/start a later side effect. Suggested bucket: other (considered test-fixture validity concern). Confidence: confirmed source analysis. proposed_drop: no existing host is reclassified and replacement ownership is explicitly established, so the suspected invalid fixture premise is refuted. Could-be-highest: no; no security/work-loss route. possible_cover: none; this is a different premise from the known lost old-session transition oracles. Caveat: this validates the synthetic interrupted-no-launch shape, not all states an older supervisor could have left. No execution performed.
